description.value: Mayuri Indian Cuisine is a family-run, fully vegetarian restaurant in Surrey specializing in South Indian cooking, with dosas as its centrepiece alongside pakoras, rice dishes, and vegetable entrees made from scratch using traditional spice blends. The restaurant has a family-focused dining room atmosphere and also offers off-site catering for parties and functions. It has received recognition on Restaurant Guru and draws a loyal local following for its authentic regional Indian flavours.
